"THE DRESS REHEARSAL"
Day: 25  Friday  10-25-24

Warm Up: Caffeinate Up!! Crack the
Knuckles. Chili Temp on lava level.

1. BACK SQUAT
1st Skit: 5 reps @ 60%, 4 @ 70%, 3 @ 80%, 2 @ 85%, 1 @ 90%
2nd Skit: 3 reps @ 82%, 2 @ 88%, 1 @ 93%
3rd Skit: 2 reps @ 90%, 1 @ 95%
10 total sets, 24 total reps
2½ to 3½ min rest between each set

2. BENCH PRESS 5 sets of 5 reps @ 70%
2 min rest between each set

3. Slow Strict Chin Ups 4 sets of 3-6 reps
2 min rest between sets. Full range of motion

super set
Cardio
a. Close Grip Bench Press
4 sets of 10 reps
b. BB Bicep Curls
4 sets of 10 reps
90 sec rest
between each super set

Recovery
Extra Meaty
Chili!!
30 min walk
Sleep Deep
and Heavy
